decisions.reason: As a biodynamic natural yogurt closely related to the firm's core organic dairy capabilities, Product A fits existing knowledge and supplier strengths, and its continued website presence from 2023 to 2024 suggests enough early acceptance to keep learning and exploit it commercially.

Product B is a mild sliced cheese that builds directly on the firm's established cheesemaking know-how, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm is well placed to interpret early market feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it after only one year.

Product C is also very close to the firm's existing cheese competences and production base, and with growing industry turnover plus the firm's own R&D and broad range, management would likely retain it to leverage and improve a highly related innovation.
